evals.expected_output: Project root contains the default skeleton=off scaffold and a successful validation result. No sample order/payment source files are generated.
expectations: The agent runs scripts/scaffold.py rather than manually writing the scaffold.

The scaffold contains build.gradle, settings.gradle, gradle.properties, .gitignore, README.md, application YAML files, DemoAppApplication.java, common exception/advice classes, and OpenApiConfig.java.
The validation result reports ok=true with skeleton=off.
Empty domain, domain/order, external, and external/payment package directories contain .gitkeep files.
OrderController.java, OrderService.java, PaymentClient.java, and OrderServiceTest.java are absent.

evals.expected_output: Full project structure with sample source files and successful validation. Packages use io.lhysin.
expectations: The agent runs scripts/scaffold.py with --skeleton on.
The scaffold includes order controller/service/repository/entity/dto files, payment client/request/response files, and OrderServiceTest.java.
All generated Java files use package declarations under io.lhysin.
Order.java has @Table(name = "orders").
OrderService.java uses @Transactional.
The validation result reports ok=true with skeleton=on.

evals.expected_output: Skill returns the script's JSON error indicating that --root is missing and does not generate project files.
expectations: The response uses the script error instead of inventing a separate error format.
The error code is INVALID_ARGUMENT or equivalent.
The message tells the user to provide --root with an example such as com.example.

evals.expected_output: Project is generated with Java version 21 and default skeleton=off behavior, followed by successful validation.
expectations: gradle.properties contains java_version=21.
The validation command uses --java-version 21.
No sample order/payment source files are generated.
The validation result reports ok=true.

evals.expected_output: Skill returns help JSON from scripts/scaffold.py showing generate and validate usage and available parameters. No project files are created.
expectations: The agent runs scripts/scaffold.py --help.
The JSON output includes generate and validate commands.
The help output includes --root, --appname, --java-version, --skeleton, --target, and wrapper-related options.

evals.expected_output: Skill returns the script's JSON error indicating that --skeleton only accepts on or off, and does not generate project files.
expectations: The response is a script-produced JSON error.
The error says --skeleton must be one of on/off.
No scaffold files are generated after invalid arguments.

evals.expected_output: If files already exist in the target, the script writes colliding generated files as .new files, reports collisions, skips wrapper generation, and validates canonical files.
expectations: Existing files are not overwritten without --force.
result.generation.collisions contains the original path and generated .new path.
Wrapper generation is skipped when collisions are present.
The final response does not claim the canonical files were overwritten.
